purpose: One reusable interface for plugging arbitrary strategies into the existing data, execution, regime, robustness and reporting infrastructure.

strategy_contract.generate_target: Input is a causal timestamp-indexed market frame plus immutable parameters and optional context frames. Output is target position in [-1,1] or explicit order intents.

layers.name: data_catalog
layers.responsibility: Load/cache/validate normalized OHLCV, trades, quotes, order book, funding and context across venues.

layers.name: feature_context
layers.responsibility: Indicators, sessions, regimes, cross-asset context and causal feature alignment.

layers.name: execution_engine
layers.responsibility: Next-bar/event execution, fees, spread, slippage, latency, partial fills and leverage/margin assumptions.

layers.name: portfolio_engine
layers.responsibility: Position accounting, capital allocation, multi-asset equity and exposure.

layers.name: experiment_engine
layers.responsibility: Parameter sweeps, symbols, timeframes, costs, folds, walk-forward and controls.

layers.name: analytics
layers.responsibility: Equity curve, EV, WR, PF, DD, MFE/MAE, concentration, turnover, cost sensitivity and regime attribution.

layers.name: evidence_registry
layers.responsibility: Immutable run manifests, candidate freezes, development/validation separation and comparable scoreboards.

backends.vectorized: Default for bar strategies and large research sweeps.
backends.event_driven: Use for tick/order-book/order-type strategies and execution-sensitive validation.

compatibility_goal: Existing strategy_tournament families should be wrapped as plugins without changing their historical definitions.
